reviews.title: A few bad stars
reviews.text:
A few bad ratings aren't because of the hosts-they're because this app constantly lags and glitches. During major events like GO Fest, random players can't even get into raids because the app fails. Instead of fixing the technical issues, you punish the people hosting raids by restricting or removing their ability to host in the future.
That's an incredibly poor business model.
If your app's performance prevents players from joining raids, the hosts shouldn't be the ones taking the blame.
They're volunteering their time to help other players, yet your system penalizes them for problems they didn't cause.
Rather than improving stability, you've built a system that shifts responsibility onto your own users.
Until the app is reliable and stops failing during the busiest events, punishing hosts for your technical shortcomings is unfair, frustrating, and completely undermines the community that keeps your platform alive.
